title: Add face detection and recognition pipeline

context.summary: Route face detection and recognition through @mindory/llm and persist provider-backed face observations for workspace auto-match.
context.background: The face subsystem already stores workspace-scoped identities and observations, but image extraction still uses deterministic people-count fallback. TASK-80 adds concrete local HTTP face provider calls through the central LLM SDK.

in: Expose local-http face detection and recognition providers from @mindory/llm.
Wire face provider and role descriptors into image semantic extraction.
Persist provider face boxes, embeddings, confidence and metadata as derived face observations.
Keep deterministic people-count fallback when face roles are disabled.
Verify workspace auto-match, rename and merge APIs with provider-backed observations.
Update docs and validators for face detection/recognition support.
out: Cloud-specific face adapters beyond the local HTTP contract.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/llm exposes local-http face detection and recognition when face roles are enabled.
Image extraction calls @mindory/llm face detection and recognition when configured.
Provider face boxes and embeddings are stored as face observations and auto-matched by workspace threshold.
Face identity list, rename and merge APIs continue to work with provider-backed observations.
Disabled face roles keep the existing fallback behavior.

manual_checks: Confirm RAW images remain immutable and face observations are derived state.

risks: Face model calls must remain inside @mindory/llm.
Provider failures must respect required/non-blocking role settings.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
